annotations.title: Resolve names to ids, find by meaning, list facets

description: kinds: brand, topic, question, market, page, site, place, or facet, surface, measure for the dictionary. Turn brand names, domains, URLs, topic, market or place names ("Austin, TX") or question wordings into Parse ids (brd_, top_, mkt_, plc_, qst_, pg_, site:), up to 25 at once: why each matched, its score, whether this workspace watches it (tracked), whether Parse has enough on a brand (indexed, thin, new, not_indexed); ambiguous lists companies sharing a name. kinds: ["facet"] (or "surface", "measure"): the dictionary of what filter.facet, filter.engine and query_metrics take, with definitions. Free.

kinds.description: what to match: brand, topic, question, market, page, site, place (default all); or facet, surface, measure alone for the dictionary

match.description: name: exact names, domains and ids (the search by meaning needs sign-in)

q.description: names, domains, URLs, question wordings or typed ids; the dictionary takes words to look for, or none

unit.description: dictionary only: facets of this unit (answer, mention, evidence, comparison, page, page_brand, question, topic_brand)
